hypothesis_chain: Deployment response that is WORLD-SPECIFIC (latent responder type) makes the sign/ordering of update improvements unpredictable from a population calibration alone; paired HF queries then carry decision value, and decision-sensitive allocation (PIVOT, exact EVSI per cost) should beat uniform allocation of the same HF budget, more so under long (strong) response than short (weak) response.
boundary_result_retained: Cohort 44000-44029 (homogeneous cooperative responder): response was systematic across worlds; a correctly specified population prior already selects the best update (LORO no-HF ISR 0.18 vs proxy 13.96 in long) and world-specific information has zero ceiling value (-0.43). That null for query value is kept and reported as the complementary boundary.
seed_disjointness: 49000-49029 disjoint from 43xxx (v3 calibration), 44xxx (v3 formal/dev), 45xxx (noise audit), 47xxx (never launched), 48xxx (v4 pilot+calibration).
responder_type_is_latent: Never provided to any selector; stored only in summary.json for post-hoc stratified reporting.
hf_cost_rule: If any query, common incumbent response training costs H once; each queried candidate costs H training + 32 native evaluation episodes. Budget = floor((cap-H)/(H+32)) queries, at most one per candidate.
calibration_source: melting_v4_calibration cohort 48000-48011 (12 roots, 6 per type). Posterior v2 hyper-parameters are fit once on all 12 and written to posterior_v2_spec.json before any 49xxx audit is read.
posterior: pivot_v2.JointGaussianDeltaPosterior: N(proxy + mu, K_prior) over the 8 candidate deployment deltas; incumbent delta 0 admissible; heteroscedastic HF noise R_c pooled by |p-.5|; exact Gaussian conditioning shared by fantasy and real queries; acquisition = exact correlated knowledge gradient / cost; stop when P(best) >= 0.95.
method_scope: All *_v2 methods share the identical posterior, update and final decision rule; they differ only in query allocation. lucb_v2 is a posterior best/challenger heuristic, not classical LUCB. Author E5C batch baselines are reported separately from the same sealed bank if the author package is importable.
primary_contrasts: H2: long, cap 192: gain(pivot_kg) - gain(uniform_v2), paired by root
primary_success_rule: Both H2 and H3 root-bootstrap 95% CI lower endpoints > 0 (10,000 draws, seed 20260917). Mechanism (H1) reported alongside: squared-gap long-minus-short CI lower > 0 and best-candidate identity differs by latent type.
secondary_prespecified: kg_stop cost and gain vs kg
if_null: Retain. Report both cohorts (homogeneous: calibration suffices; heterogeneous: whatever is found). Do not add seeds, do not change lambda/horizons/caps, do not re-tune the posterior on 49xxx.
inference_unit: root seed (30). Candidate rows and episodes are not independent replicates.
compute: 30 roots x 704 episodes = 21,120 native episodes; ~2 h per root single-thread; 20 workers -> ~3.5 h wallclock
freeze_procedure: Codex: after pilot_go == true AND preflight gate PASS, copy this file to melting_v4_confirm.json, set status FROZEN, add source_file_hashes for code/*.py and the calibration posterior_v2_spec.json sha256, and commit the hash in the launch log BEFORE running any 49xxx seed.
